•	 Candidates	answer	on	the	Question	Paper	in	the	spaces	provided.	
•	 Write	your	Centre	Number,	Candidate	Number	and	Name	in	the	spaces	at	the	top	of	this	
page	and	on	all	separate	answer	sheets	used.

•	 The	businesses	mentioned	in	this	question		
paper	are	entirely	fictitious.
